pull_request.body:
<!-- uv-active-slice: legacy-music-action-envelope-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: legacy-music-action-envelope-retirement -->

## Goal

Retire the duplicate Product Orchestrator mutation/action envelope for legacy `music_video` projects while preserving the temporary read-only Music workflow/readiness projection, the legacy Music UI, direct Music domain APIs/capability execution and all project-owned Music state.

## Changes

The five Music Product Workflow mutation actions (`save_music_map`, `save_music_direction`, `save_music_assembly`, `render_music_master`, `review_music_master`) and Music-specific backend dispatch glue are retired. `GET /api/uv/projects/{id}/workflow` remains as temporary read compatibility.

The specialized Music clients keep their UI-facing functions but now use the established direct authorities:

- Music Map → `/music-map/commands`;
- Music Director → `/music-direction/commands`;
- Music Assembly → `/music-assembly/commands`;
- master render → `video.render_music_video` capability execution with `local_free_first`;
- final Review → `/music-video-review`.

Browser acceptance requires zero Music POSTs to `/workflow/actions/` and positively observes all five direct mutation paths while preserving the same rendered artifact, approved Review and ready workflow state.

## Review finding and repair

Review head `cd5bea656ef2e7612bda46f9c324d933103860ae` had exact-head CI 5/5, but an unresolved P2 correctly identified that moving render to the direct capability had dropped the old `rhythm_aligned` prerequisite. Independent validation confirmed that BASE `render_music_master` was enabled only when `assembly is not None and rhythm_aligned and render_ready`, while `render_music_video_state()` validated revisions/media but did not run `MusicDirectionStore.rhythm_audit()`.

PR #95 was returned to Draft before material changes. Scope was expanded only to `uv_studio/capabilities/adapters/music_video_render.py` and `tests_real_media/test_music_video_render_real_media.py`; scope head `654618a6c854225d9c221e34bfe564985c727c61` passed `development-context` before those files were edited.

The direct capability now restores the prerequisite at the canonical execution boundary: the current Music Director rhythm audit must report `summary.all_aligned == true` before source probing or FFmpeg render begins.

CI #4883 exposed a flaw only in the first regression fixture: the test placed an explicitly assigned sync marker outside its shot, so `MusicDirectionStore.set_direction()` correctly rejected the fixture before rhythm audit. Current Draft head `cb9852c6ee8b59020d00c0adc8c1b309705cced2` fixes the fixture without changing runtime. The misaligned case now leaves the cut unbound, which is a valid persisted Director state; `rhythm_audit()` compares its 2.5 s cut with the nearest 3.0 s global marker and yields a 500,000 µs misalignment. The test also injects a runner that fails on any FFmpeg/FFprobe invocation, requiring the API to return 422 before media execution and to create no render artifact. The existing aligned real-media render path remains unchanged.

No Music UI component, new endpoint, replacement planner or Product Workflow mutation action was introduced. Photo Composer, Visualizer, broader Product Orchestrator, Stage8 and other directions remain out of scope.

## Verification

Base remains lifecycle-closed `main` `57bbbec41b2e82e556d620efb21f3b6cdf2a5a47` after accepted execution-plan retirement PR #93 and closure PR #94.

Before the P2 repair, material head `bf11b97f9a6ef4c3d57e15831cf3b855cabf4dd2` passed CI #4871/#4872 and review head `cd5bea656ef2e7612bda46f9c324d933103860ae` passed a valid Ready exact-head 5/5 run. That review identity is superseded.

Scope-expanded Draft head `654618a6c854225d9c221e34bfe564985c727c61` passed `development-context`. Runtime guard commit `ec80770a9da217f25f2efce6355295b244e42a6f` added the canonical rhythm audit gate. Current Draft head is `cb9852c6ee8b59020d00c0adc8c1b309705cced2`; final Draft acceptance requires all five permanent jobs SUCCESS on this exact head with the current PR metadata.

## Architecture impact

This remains a bounded D-070 authority reduction. Product Workflow is temporary read-only compatibility state for the legacy Music page; Music mutations are owned by established Music domain APIs and Capability authority. Execution-plan retirement is already accepted through PR #93/#94. Internal Recipe Registry, broader Product Orchestrator, Stage8 and persisted-project compatibility remain separately scheduled work.

## Known limitations

This slice does not migrate the whole legacy Music page to modern Studio, retire Product Orchestrator GET/read state, remove Stage8, alter other directions, change Music storage/domain services, or complete the `micro_drama` golden vertical.

## Next task

Require all five permanent jobs SUCCESS on exact Draft head `cb9852c6ee8b59020d00c0adc8c1b309705cced2` with current metadata. Then perform a context-only Draft→review refreeze, mark PR #95 Ready, require exact new review-head 5/5, reply to and resolve the confirmed P2 thread with exact fix evidence, and obtain a new genuinely fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review on the new frozen BASE/HEAD.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the rhythm gate on direct renders**

When the current Music Director has unaligned cuts, this direct capability request now reaches `render_music_video_state`, which validates revisions and media but never runs `rhythm_audit`; the UI's render button is also enabled for every saved assembly. Previously, `render_music_master` was disabled unless `rhythm_aligned` was true, so this migration allows an unusable master artifact to consume render time before the final review rejects approval. Restore this prerequisite at the canonical direct execution boundary so frontend behavior and backend acceptance remain compatible.
